factual_errors.text: Without control, this becomes an explosion (atomic bomb).
factual_errors.correction: This overstates the link. The specification says that 'The explosion caused by a nuclear weapon is caused by an uncontrolled chain reaction.' The reverse is not true: an uncontrolled chain reaction does not always become an atomic-bomb explosion. A reactor whose chain reaction goes out of control overheats or melts down. It does not detonate like a weapon. A weapon needs specially prepared fuel brought together quickly so the chain reaction grows extremely fast. The lesson should say that a nuclear weapon's explosion is caused by an uncontrolled chain reaction, not that any uncontrolled chain reaction becomes an atomic bomb.
